title: Not Sauron
description: In the Greenwood the Mystics hail the Stranger as Lord Sauron and try to carry him east. The Harfoots come to his rescue; he takes up the Mystics' staff and scatters them — and as they vanish they call him something else: Istar. Sadoc dies of his wound at sunrise.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: A smith from the Southlands
description: Six days' ride brings Galadriel and the wounded Halbrand to Eregion, just as Gil-galad is about to end Celebrimbor's work. Healed, Halbrand offers the great smith a thought: do not stretch the mithril — alloy it.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The king is dead
description: Tar-Palantir dies. Eärien, sent to sketch him for his tomb, finds the palantír uncovered and waiting.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Halbrand unmasked
description: An old scroll proves that the line of Southland kings died out a thousand years ago. Confronted by the river, Halbrand drops the mask — he is Sauron — and offers Galadriel a throne at his side. She refuses him.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Three Rings for the Elven-kings
description: Galadriel tells no one who Halbrand was — only that there must be three, to balance one another. Her brother's dagger is melted down for its gold and silver of Valinor, and Narya, Nenya and Vilya are made.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The fleet comes home to black sails
description: Míriel and Elendil sail home to a harbour hung with mourning. Elendil sees the banners; the blind queen cannot.

title: Nori chooses the road
description: The Harfoots move on under a new trail-finder. Nori leaves her family to go with the Stranger toward the lands of Rhûn, where the stars he remembers can be found.

title: The Harfoots travel on
description: Poppy stays with the caravan as it sets out again.

title: Sauron enters Mordor
description: Alone, the one who was Halbrand crosses the mountains and looks down on the burning mountain and the land made ready for him.
